xwhatsapp-strokecopylinkgoogleAdd Al Jazeera on GoogleinfoA truck loaded with firewood drives in Aden, Yemen, October 13, 2026 [File: Abdulnasser Alseddik/AP Photo]By Al Jazeera StaffPublished On 21 Oct 202621 Oct 2026|Updated: an hour agoUpdated: an hour agoA powerful explosion has been heard in the city of Aden in southern Yemen, an Al Jazeera journalist and police official said.

A police official said on Wednesday that smoke was rising near the airport in Aden, which is controlled by the internationally recognised Yemeni government.

Reporting from Yemen’s Taiz, Al Jazeera’s Maha Ali said “the Houthi group targeted Aden airport with a ballistic missile”.

Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said the group targeted the Saudi-led coalition’s “military operation room at the Badr Camp in Aden with a ballistic missile”.

He said that “the strike was precise and direct”.
